query: Set the text-to-3D generation node's geometry quality to 'detailed' so the model captures more surface features like wrinkles and folds, and leave its face-limit and quad settings exactly as they are so the polygon count does not grow.

desired.outcome: The generated model has more surface detail (e.g., wrinkles, folds) from the detailed geometry-quality setting while keeping the same polygon budget.
desired.quality: The generation node's geometry quality is set to 'detailed', its face-limit and quad settings are unchanged, all other nodes remain connected with no dangling nodes, and the pipeline stages (texturing, rigging, retargeting) still work correctly.

_tags.author_rationale: This query targets a specific, actionable single-widget change: set TripoTextToModelNode.geometry_quality to 'detailed' while leaving the face-limit (-1) and quad (false) settings untouched, forcing the agent to locate the generation node's quality combo without disturbing the polygon budget.
